targets.notes: Every modmail payload runs this lookahead regex once per key. A recorded conversations listing has about 7000 keys and only about 200 distinct ones, and snake_case_keys calls camel_to_snake on each of them. A small cache or a straight character scan should replace the per-key regex; a local cache prototype was about 14x faster on that listing.

replace_more starts by walking the whole comment tree with list.pop(0) and by iterating each CommentForest through __getitem__ (IndexError protocol). The bench builds ~2000 nodes from the recorded 3hahrw thread, a size the suite already fully expands. A deque plus walking the child list directly was about 6x faster in a local prototype.
